title: joints
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/joints, ROS to HA, QoS 0, not retained, message expiry 5 s. Added 2026-10-14 (0.2.0) as an optional, additive part of schema 1. Joint positions in the unit and order of the announce joints block; published only by a node whose announce carries that block, at most telemetry.joints_rate_hz times per second (default 2), only when a position moved by more than telemetry.joints_min_delta since the last publish, plus once on every (re)connect and announce. seq increments per publication within a session and HA drops a regressing seq within the same session. HA shows the values as one sensor per joint and never records them by default.

positions.description: One position per announced joint, in the announced unit and in the order of the announced names. The length must equal the number of announced names; a schema cannot check that against another message, so both halves check it in code and HA drops a payload whose length differs.

velocities.description: null when the executor reports no velocities, otherwise one velocity per announced joint in the announced unit per second, same length and order as positions.
